text_block_list.text:
Cheers envelop the victor.
At the center of that circle was
<chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Breakthrough!! What outstanding finishing speed that was!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. With your skills, you can take on
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe too. No problem.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Now then,
let's go show <chrname> some appreciation!

Together with both of them,
I rush over to <chrname>.
Next up is—the "Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe."
